entities.summary: Larry Demetrius Williams is an American former professional basketball player. He played college basketball for Wake Forest University and is the only Demon Deacon in school history to garner multiple ACC All-Defensive team honors. He is 6'4" and plays both shooting guard and small forward. currently working as an assistant coach for the Long Island Nets of the NBA G League.
